cells.name: spagetti
cells.description: a loose diagonal fan of long, thin, straight, golden-yellow dried spaghetti strands. Uncooked hard pasta rods of uniform round cross-section, visibly thin, both ends in frame. No curves, nests, sauce, plate, herbs, flour or other shapes of pasta.

cells.name: hamburgerbrød
cells.description: one soft, round golden burger bun with a domed top cut horizontally in half. The domed top has a few sesame seeds and sits next to the bottom half with the fluffy cut face upward. Entire plain empty bread bun visible with no burger patty, greens, filling, condiments or packaging.
